## What to Test

- [ ] Basic code review (missing documentation)
- [ ] Error handling detection
- [ ] Code quality (unused variables, complexity)
- [ ] Security vulnerabilities
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Test coverage
- [ ] Best practices

## Steps

1. Create a feature branch
2. Make code changes
3. Run tests locally
4. Push and create PR
5. Wait for CodeRabbit review
6. Document results
